label: FireRedTTS3 Space voice-design adapter
summary: Use the linked public FireRedTTS3 Space as an optional reference-free voice-design instrument, preserving the remote revision, prompts, seeds, raw cues, checksums, and any separate EPRS pitch treatment.

handoffs.label: Generate original FireRedTTS3 voice cues
handoffs.intent: Turn a bounded cue list and original character description into song-local speech samples that can be arranged or explicitly pitch-treated without supplying a human reference voice.
inputs: A short cue list, original synthetic voice description, seed, CFG, flow steps, and declared output role
Explicit permission to send the cue text and voice description to the public Hugging Face Space
For pitch correction: a player-facing reason plus an explicit key, scale, and preset
outputs: New song-local PCM WAV cues outside recordings/raw and FINAL
A manifest with Space/model identity, Space revision, request controls, generated voice plan, checksums, and rights boundary
When tuning is requested, preserved raw cues plus per-cue EPRS autotune sidecars
steps: Inspect the current Space endpoint and model card; do not assume an unchanged API, revision, license, or runtime.
Run `scripts/firered_tts3_voice.py` in reference-free voice-design mode with the smallest useful cue batch; never put credentials in arguments or manifests.
If autotune is requested, preserve the raw response and apply only the declared EPRS key, scale, and preset.
Compare each cue in the full arrangement and promote only a useful candidate through the normal EPRS review gates.
verification: Confirm the downloaded response is a non-empty PCM WAV with the recorded format, duration, and checksum.
Confirm the manifest contains the exact Space revision when available, prompt, per-cue seed, inference controls, voice plan, and no token value.
Confirm no human reference audio was uploaded, the voice is represented as synthetic, and altered-content disclosure is carried into publication metadata.

preserve: Every generated raw cue, processed alternative, request parameter, revision, voice plan, checksum, and rights/disclosure note
The distinction between public-Space remote processing, local EPRS pitch processing, and creative or release approval
avoid: Uploading private voice recordings, cloning or imitating an identifiable person, sending secrets, retrying rate limits in a loop, or hiding failed outputs
Treating public availability or Apache-2.0 as blanket clearance for user inputs, person likeness, generated content, or downstream publication
